definitions.explanation: Used to indicate that something is done to an excessive or unreasonable degree.
Doing something without proper consideration or care, often randomly or haphazardly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧やたら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧やたら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}して→質問する：05637_shitsumonsuru⟧くる。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧やたら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}くて→眠い：00872_nemui⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}できない→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I've been excessively sleepy lately and can't concentrate on work.

examples.japanese: やたら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}らないで→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
やたら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{個人情報|こじんじょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't recklessly give out personal information.

notes:
FORMS:
- やたら (basic form)
- やたら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial form)
- やたら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (adverbial form, more colloquial)
- やたらな (na-adjective form)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- やたら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ - excessively many
- やたら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ - to eat indiscriminately
- やたらな⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧ - reckless remarks

ALTERNATIVE WRITING:
Also written as {矢鱈|やたら} (ateji).

USAGE:
Carries a slightly negative connotation, suggesting excess or lack of proper judgment. More casual than ⟦{過度|かど}→過度：14377_kado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or {無闇|むやみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.
